verdict.rationale: RustDesk's repository includes its own clipboard library implementing file copy and paste on Windows, Linux and macOS, so some clipboard transfer exists. A hands-on user reports file copy-paste from Linux to Windows doesn't work, and nothing in the pack documents text clipboard sync, both-way sync, or a switch to turn it off. Missing for 10: documented bidirectional text clipboard sync between host and viewer, a documented per-session or global toggle to disable clipboard sharing, reliable cross-platform behavior (the Linux-to-Windows failure).

support.subject: As a power user, the clipboard moves both ways between host and viewer, and I can turn that off

citations.quote: libs/clipboard: file copy and paste implementation for Windows, Linux, macOS.
